scenarios.theme: Two current reads both return free. Can both reservations succeed?
scenarios.assumptions: Clients perform separate read and unconditional write calls against a linearizable register. What will you do and why?

concept-specificity.rationale: Applies Strong Consistency to concurrent reserve.

direct-answer.rationale: Reviewed action: Expose reserve-if-free as an atomic conditional operation at the authoritative object or use the required transaction boundary; handle a failed condition e

decision-costs.rationale: Reviewed cost/alternative: Contention can reject callers and require a new decision

follow-up.rationale: Reviewed trap: Faster current reads do not make the pair atomic; if reservations span several resources, a larger transaction/workflow decision is needed.
